briefdescription.para: Returns the client XilSecure library version, frozen at compile time.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a 32-bit word that receives the client library version packed as XIL_BUILD_VERSION(Major, Minor).

listitem.para: XST_INVALID_PARAM - If Version pointer is NULL

briefdescription.para: Queries the XilSecure server (PLM) library information - version and capability bitmaps - by issuing a Features command with an always-present crypto api-id.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the client instance (mailbox handle + SlrIndex).
Pointer to a Xil_LibInfo structure that receives the server library version (LibVersion) and capability bitmap words.

listitem.para: XST_INVALID_PARAM - If InstancePtr or LibInfo is NULL
Error - On SMC/mailbox transport failure or if the Features command fails

simplesect.para: The Features command is sent with a valid crypto api-id so the server command SUCCEEDS and returns the full response buffer, in which the library version/capability are reported at fixed indices ([3]/[4]). A server too old to report capabilities leaves those words at 0, which the caller reads as "no capability advertised" - the safe default.

briefdescription.para: Queries the XilSecure server (PLM) library version.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the client instance (mailbox handle + SlrIndex).
Pointer to a 32-bit word that receives the server library version packed as XIL_BUILD_VERSION(Major, Minor).

listitem.para: XST_INVALID_PARAM - If InstancePtr or Version pointer is NULL

briefdescription.para: Verifies that the client XilSecure library is compatible with the running server (PLM) XilSecure library.

para.verbatim: The client compile-time version (XSecure_GetLibVersion()) is compared against the version reported by the server. Compatibility requires the major versions to match and the client minor version to be less than or equal to the server minor version (a newer server stays backward compatible with an older client).

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the client instance (mailbox handle + SlrIndex).

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS - Client and server library versions are compatible
XSECURE_LIB_VERSION_MINOR_MISMATCH - Client minor is newer than the server
XST_INVALID_PARAM / Error - On transport failure while querying the server

briefdescription.para: Tests whether a given capability bit is advertised in a library capability word previously fetched with XSecure_GetServerLibInfo().

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a populated Xil_LibInfo structure.
Capability bit position (one of the XSECURE_CAP_*_BIT values).

listitem.para: TRUE - The capability is compiled into the running server
FALSE - The capability is absent, or LibInfo is NULL, or CapBit is out of range

briefdescription.para: This file contains the client-side implementation of the XilSecure library version compatibility check.

detaileddescription.para: It queries the server (PLM) library version over the IPI mailbox and compares it against the client's compile-time version.
